title: The Matches That Built Mumbai Indians’s Reputation Under Pressure
dek: Reputations are built in tight finishes. Mumbai Indians' narrowest wins, finals and super overs are the matches that defined how they handle pressure.
excerpt: Mumbai Indians have won many close matches and played in finals and super overs. Those are the matches that built their reputation under pressure, listed here from the narrowest down.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: Where Reputations Are Made
body: A franchise's reputation for handling pressure is built from a handful of matches: the finals, the super overs and the wins by a run or a ball.
Mumbai Indians have won {{ev:mp-n}} close matches and played {{ev:mp-finals}} finals, winning {{ev:mp-titles}}.

body: Their narrowest win came {{ev:mp-first}}. The table lists the ten narrowest, super overs first, then by margin.

sections.heading: Finals
body: Finals are the highest-pressure matches a franchise plays. Mumbai Indians have played {{ev:mp-finals}} and won {{ev:mp-titles}}.

sections.heading: Reputation Versus Record
body: A reputation for handling pressure often rests on a few memorable matches. The close-match record elsewhere in this series tests whether it holds across all of them.
Memorable wins are real; whether they reflect a repeatable skill is a statistical question.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: The Matches That Made the Name
body: Mumbai Indians' narrowest wins, finals and super overs are the core of their pressure reputation.
The list here is the archive any retelling of that reputation should start from.
